calls.title: Growthbook <> Groupon - Pro Sync
calls.summary: In this call, GrowthBook’s Daniel Wathne (sales) and Logan (solutions engineer) discussed Groupon’s usage of GrowthBook with Michal Pekarcik (experimentation lead, leaving at month-end). Pain points included previous underbilling due to a November pricing model change and Groupon’s need to control costs by limiting seats; Daniel proposed an enterprise plan (~$50k/year) with unlimited users, SSO, RBAC, and dedicated support. Key participants included Groupon's product director Michal Zachar and product operations lead Blanka Pauerova.
